'''Shirayama-hime Shrine''' (白山比咩神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=shrine}} in Japan.

* {{ill|Shirayama Hime Shrine|en|Shirayama Hime Shrine|qid=Q704702|lt=Shirayama Hime Shrine}} - Located in {{ill|Hakusan, Ishikawa|en|Hakusan, Ishikawa|qid=Q696407|lt=Hakusan}}, {{ill|Ishikawa Prefecture|en|Ishikawa Prefecture|qid=Q131281|lt=Ishikawa Prefecture}}, in Sannomiya-chō. The head shrine of all {{ill|Hakusan Shrine|ja|白山神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakusan Shrines|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11579587}} in Japan.
